basic_details.scholarship_name: Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM) Graduate Research Assistant Scheme & Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: Universiti Sains Malaysia (School of Computer Sciences & Institute of Postgraduate Studies - IPS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Universiti Sains Malaysia Main Campus (Penang, Malaysia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Computer Sciences: Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity & Network Security, Cloud Computing, and Computer Vision.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 Graduate Research Assistant (GRA) and USM Fellowship packages awarded annually across research faculties
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani postgraduate researchers represent a major cohort in USM computing labs (~15 to 30 awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for MSc Research; up to 3-4 years for PhD, renewed semi-annually based on research milestones

nationality_requirements: Open to international and Malaysian citizens holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MSc; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.30+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: USM requires minimum CGPA of 2.75 for admission, but GRA funding schemes require minimum CGPA 3.00 on a 4.0 scale.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Coursework in programming, algorithms, databases, operating systems, and computer networks.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year students can apply conditionally; final degree certificate required before registration.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; technical research publications (Scopus/WoS indexed) provide a substantial advantage for GRA selection.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 5.0, TOEFL iBT min 40, PTE Academic min 47, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; postgraduate research in School of Computer Sciences is conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates secure funding by being appointed to funded research grants (FRGS, PRGS, CREST, industry grants) held by USM computer science professors.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold multiple full-time employment contracts simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: Tuition fees are either fully waived via the USM Fellowship or reimbursed through the supervisor's research grant allocation (~MYR 12,000 to MYR 16,000 / year value; ~USD 2,700 to 3,600).

admission_application_fee.details: USM international postgraduate online application fee of USD 35 (~MYR 160) paid via credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus student hostels (Desasiswa Bakti, Desasiswa Saujana) or off-campus apartments in Sungai Dua / Bukit Gambir near Penang campus average MYR 350 to 650/month (~USD 80 to 145/month for private bedroom in shared condo).

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free research stipend: MSc by Research receives MYR 1,500 to MYR 2,300 / month (~USD 340 to 520 / month; ~PKR 93,000 to 142,600 / month); PhD receives MYR 2,500 to MYR 3,500 / month (~USD 565 to 790 / month; ~PKR 155,000 to 217,000 / month) paid from grant funds.

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Penang International Airport (PEN) / Kuala Lumpur (KUL) are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) visa processing fee and Malaysian Student Pass fee of approx. MYR 2,000 to 2,500 (~USD 450 to 560).

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive student medical and hospitalization insurance is included within the annual EMGS student pass package, covering hospital care across Malaysia.

food_allowance.details: Campus cafeterias and Penang food courts offer world-renowned local cuisine for MYR 7 to 12 per meal; easily covered by the monthly GRA stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to USM Hamzah Sendut Library, School of Computer Sciences high-performance computing clusters, and lab hardware.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research supervisor project grants (FRGS/CREST) cover registration, travel, and accommodation for presenting research at Scopus/IEEE conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Rapid Penang student bus concession card provides unlimited bus travel across Penang island for approx. MYR 35/month.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single premier Malaysian APEX research university: Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM, Penang, Malaysia)
participating_institutions: Collaborative Research in Engineering, Science & Technology (CREST)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 150 global university (QS World #146, QS Asia #32); Malaysia's designated APEX university (Accelerated Programme for Excellence) with top-ranked computing and software research facilities.
available_majors: MSc / PhD by Research in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
MSc / PhD by Research in Data Engineering & Business Analytics
MSc / PhD by Research in Cybersecurity & Cloud Networks (NAv6)
MSc / PhD by Research in Software Engineering & Distributed Systems
MSc / PhD by Research in Computer Vision & Image Processing
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MSc Research: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years full-time.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD) in CS/STEM with 3.0+ GPA, structured research proposal (3-5 pages), prospective supervisor endorsement, 2 recommendation letters, and English proficiency (IELTS 5.0+ or MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI and Computer Vision labs have high applicant interest; Cybersecurity (NAv6), Cloud Networking, and Software Engineering offer higher appointment probability for candidates with practical coding and systems skills.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: GRA positions are tied to specific faculty research grants (e.g. FRGS, CREST); contact School of Computer Sciences professors directly with a CV and research proposal to find an active grant holder who will sponsor your GRA contract.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: USM Postgraduate Online Admissions Portal & IPS System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Review faculty directory in School of Computer Sciences, contact prospective supervisor to secure GRA sponsorship, then submit formal online application on the USM admissions portal.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (Ongoing / Year-round): Review School of Computer Sciences research profiles and email professors with CV and research proposal.
Step 2 (Secure supervisor agreement): Obtain confirmation from a professor that they have an active grant to support you as a Graduate Research Assistant (GRA).
Step 3 (Online application): Create account on admission.usm.my/postgraduate, select Master's or PhD by Research in Computer Science, and indicate prospective supervisor.
Step 4 (Upload materials): Upload certified PDF scans of transcripts, degree certificates, research proposal, CV, and English certificate / MOI letter.
Step 5 (Fee payment): Pay USD 35 application fee online and submit.
Step 6 (Faculty review): School of Computer Sciences verifies qualifications and issues formal Offer of Admission.
Step 7 (Visa processing): Submit EMGS visa application online; receive Electronic Visa Approval Letter (eVAL).
Step 8 (Arrival & contract): Travel to Penang, complete medical checkup, register at IPS, and sign GRA employment contract with research supervisor.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated supervisor sponsorship: Funding is secured through appointment to a funded faculty grant simultaneously with or immediately upon academic admission.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly to the admissions portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of research intent: Outline research background, proposed research domain, and alignment with target research lab.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing background, problem statement, research objectives, proposed methodology, and expected contributions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20-30 minute virtual interview via Google Meet conducted by prospective supervisor evaluating research proposal and technical background.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (5.0+), TOEFL iBT (40+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation recommended for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the USM Postgraduate Admissions Portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Certified copy of original degree certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD); HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale explanation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 3 to 5-page research proposal detailing problem statement, research significance, methodology, and expected contributions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on computing research problems aligned with supervisor's active research grants.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official letter or email endorsement from a USM computer science professor agreeing to supervise and sponsor applicant.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Crucial for securing GRA funding; obtain directly from prospective professor.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed academic CV in English listing education, research experience, publications, technical skills, and honors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly highlight publications (Scopus/IEEE), final-year project, and software development tools.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two recommendation letters from university professors assessing research capability.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit on official university letterhead with institutional email (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.document_name: English Language Proficiency Certificate or MOI
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (5.0+), TOEFL (40+), or official Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter from university registrar.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official English MOI letter from Pakistani university registrar is accepted by USM.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport bio-data page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure passport is valid beyond intended arrival in Malaysia.

important_dates_timeline.application_open_date: Continuous / Year-round (Admissions open throughout the year)
important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 30 June (Semester 1 / October Intake) / 30 November (Semester 2 / March Intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two main intake cycles per year (October and March), with research students able to enroll year-round upon supervisor agreement.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Academic record, undergraduate/master's GPA, performance in core computing coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality of research proposal, prior Scopus/IEEE publications, technical capabilities)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 10% (Relevant software engineering or research lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and alignment with supervisor's grant objectives)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Qualifying factor (virtual interview with prospective supervisor)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: School of Computer Sciences Postgraduate Committee and Institute of Postgraduate Studies (IPS).
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Supervisor-driven grant appointment: The prospective supervisor assesses the candidate's research proposal, interview, and publication record, and appoints the candidate to their funded research grant (FRGS/CREST). The university IPS confirms admission and issues the formal contract.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 1,500+ international postgraduate applicants across USM science and engineering schools
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 150 GRA and fellowship positions awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~15% to 22% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants with supervisor endorsement
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate/Master's degree in CS/SE/IT from recognized Pakistani university (FAST, NUST, UET, GIKI, COMSATS), strong programming skills, solid research proposal, MOI or IELTS 6.0+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore/Taxila, GIKI, and COMSATS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Nigeria, China, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Iraq, Yemen

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized recruiters charging placement fees claiming guaranteed admission or GRA positions at USM. Applications are processed strictly via admission.usm.my.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: USM application fee is USD 35 paid online directly to the university. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: USM works with authorized international agents for coursework, but research degrees and GRA positions are secured directly through faculty. Never pay agents for GRA placement.
hidden_costs_breakdown: EMGS visa processing fee & student pass: ~MYR 2,200 (~PKR 135,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Penang/KL: ~PKR 150,000 to 240,000.
First month's rent deposit in Penang: ~MYR 1,000 (~PKR 62,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: You must take IELTS or TOEFL. (FACT: USM officially accepts English Medium of Instruction certificates from Pakistani universities).
CLAIM: All admitted students automatically get a GRA position. (FACT: GRA funding depends on finding a professor who has an active grant; you must secure supervisor agreement).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some student forums claim that GRA stipends are delayed for months. In practice, initial EMGS and bank account setup takes 4-6 weeks; students should arrive with 1-2 months of living funds (~USD 500).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory research progress ratings on semi-annual progress reports submitted to IPS.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research enrollment on campus in Penang.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual research progress reports and milestone presentations reviewed by the thesis supervisory committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: GRA recipients work on designated research grant projects (typically 20 hours/week of research duties aligned with thesis); outside commercial employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates can seek employment in Malaysia's booming Penang semiconductor and tech sector (Silicon Island) or pursue postdoctoral research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill designated research deliverables (publishing Scopus/WoS indexed papers, attending project meetings).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research topic requires approval from the supervisor and school committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: MSc GRA funding typically capped at 2 years; PhD GRA funding capped at 3-4 years depending on grant duration.
